Overview

Analyze, understand, and visualize your data with ease

Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel unlocks the latest AI capabilities to help you achieve your goals—from creating a simple spreadsheet to conducting advanced data analysis.
  • Tell Copilot what to change and it can help edit—formulas, tables, and formatting. Review the changes and stay in control.
    Try Copilot in Excel
  • Let Copilot do your calculations for you. Ask for help figuring out the perfect formula for your data.
    Try Copilot in Excel
  • From adding new columns to highlighting key information, Copilot can help with formatting.
Key Features

Do more with your data

Copilot in Excel

Stay in the flow of work with insightful assistance and smart tips on your spreadsheets from Copilot.
Learn more

Simplify your data

Go from a simple prompt to deep insights with Copilot building directly in your spreadsheet - no advanced Excel skills required.
Learn more

Share and collaborate

Share worksheets with peers and team members for easy collaboration and to offer data, insights, and reports.3
Learn more
